question: The largest area of the Great Indian Desert in India is located in which state?
solution: The correct answer is __**Rajasthan**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The **Great Indian Desert**, commonly known as the **Thar Desert**, is predominantly located in the northwestern part of **India**. • The majority of the desert, covering approximately **60% of its total area**, lies in the state of **Rajasthan**, making it the state with the largest desert area. • The desert spans across districts such as **Jaisalmer, Barmer, Bikaner, and Jodhpur**, with **Jaisalmer** being known as the "Golden City" due to its iconic sand dunes. • Rajasthan’s arid climate and sandy terrain, coupled with minimal rainfall (less than **150 mm annually**), contribute to the expansive desert landscape. • The Thar Desert also extends into parts of **Gujarat, Punjab, and Haryana**, but these states hold a much smaller portion of the desert compared to Rajasthan.
